disambiguation: Not an AI service or exporter; it organizes and manages existing exported Markdown files.
extras: Local-first design ensures no data is uploaded or collected; optional companion browser tools exist for easier export.
intentEvidence: Turn exported AI conversations into a private, searchable knowledge hub inside Obsidian.
motivation: To bring exported conversations from various AI services together in one local library so they can remain useful after the original chat is over.
problem: Research and knowledge generated across multiple AI services become scattered and difficult to reuse once the original chat session ends.
summary: A tool that organizes and searches exported conversations from various AI services into local Markdown files within the Obsidian vault.
